April 2005: It Never Stops Raining in Rainier Falls

Adele's death was officially recorded as a "suicide," but it's an illusion. Can you unravel the web of lies the suspects have carefully constructed together? Remember: the suspects are ready to hunt you down, and every document hides a lie. Break the silence with your intellect!

Search for the Truth Between the Pages

It Was Not a Suicide is a document-driven detective investigation simulator set in the misty atmosphere of 2005. More than a classic adventure game, it places the bureaucratic burden and dark reality of a genuine investigation on your shoulders.

Key Features:

  • In-Depth Investigation:
    Examine police reports, autopsy documents, interrogation transcripts, and suspects' journals word by word. Find the contradictions and expose the lies.

  • Retro Digital Detective Work:
    Step back into the technology of the 2000s. Use the POISON-OS terminal system to access confidential hospital records and encrypted files.

  • Detective's Intuition:
    When you lose your way in the darkness of the investigation and hit a dead end, cryptic notes appearing on the corkboard will guide your thoughts. The system never gives you the answer directly; it only whispers the truth to help you focus on the right clues.

  • Solve the Mystery:
    Uncover the dirty schemes hidden within the sterile hallways of this psychiatric clinic and expose the secrets the suspects are hiding. Remember: you can't afford to make a mistake you must identify the real culprit on your first and only attempt.

    Are you ready to uncover the truth? Wishlist it now and be among the first to explore the darkness of Rainier Falls.

I just wanted to bring my bro home for some grilled fish and gains. Somehow I punched through the entire Hell Dynasty.

Your musclebound best friend Tiezhu has been kidnapped by the Princess of Hell herself. You — a frontier villager whose only life goal was napping — grab a sword and set off to get him back. Idle grinding × loot hunting × a comedy that keeps twisting: it grows stronger while you're away, and you grow stronger when you take the wheel.

[Fully Automatic Combat]
Auto-targeting, auto-skills: progress happens while you idle. Chant devastating mage AoEs or carve through packs in melee — two class trees with 16 ultimate specializations to respec into, anytime.

[Fighting Is a Side Job — Living Is the Game]
Woodcutting, mining, fishing, farming, cooking, smithing, alchemy — seven life skills, all idle-friendly, all feeding your power: food buffs, combat potions, smelted ingots for upgrades. Build your anti-Hell hometown, one building at a time.

[Loot, Then Loot Some More]
Five rarity tiers, random affixes, enhancing, socketing, gems and enchants — every single monster might drop the item that rewrites your build.

[Rebirth, Come Back Stronger]
Rebirth at any moment: keep your gear, life skills and town, reroll your class, and earn Nirvana Stones to light up permanent talents — pushing the level cap from 240 all the way to 300.

[The Sky Tower: Climb Without End]
Max level is not the finish line. Enter the infinitely tall Sky Tower, where every floor hits harder — take the build of a lifetime as high as it goes and race the world on the global leaderboard. (Leaderboard requires an online account; offline climbing is unrestricted.)

[A 20-Chapter Comedy of Betrayed Expectations]
The kidnapped bro is… thriving in Hell? The "villain" princess has her reasons? Snark your way through 20 chapters and pick the ending yourself.

Italian Street Food Simulator is a first-person cooking and management game where you run your own street food business in a lively Italian coastal town.

Prepare food, take care of your customers, manage your supplies, keep your stand running smoothly, and reinvest your earnings as your small business grows day by day.

PREPARE ITALIAN STREET FOOD

Build a growing menu of Italian street-food favorites and prepare each order yourself. Work directly with ingredients and cooking equipment as you fry, press, bake, assemble, and serve food to your customers.

As your business grows, new recipes and equipment add new steps to your daily workflow and give you more to manage during busy service hours.

SERVE AT THE COUNTER OR AT THE TABLE

Not every customer is served the same way.

Take care of walk-up customers looking for a quick meal, or serve guests who choose to sit at one of your tables. Prepare each order, choose the right way to serve it, and make sure it reaches the correct customer.

Seated service also means more work after the meal. Collect used plates and cups, wash reusable tableware, clear the tables, and get everything ready for your next guests.

KEEP YOUR STAND STOCKED

A busy food stand needs more than good cooking.

Keep track of your ingredients and supplies, visit the local market when you need to restock, and make sure you have everything required to get through the day.

Good preparation can make the difference when several customers arrive at once.

MANAGE THE DAILY RUSH

Orders can quickly pile up as your business becomes more popular.

Decide what to prepare first, keep different cooking stations moving, manage your available tableware and supplies, and serve customers without letting your workflow fall apart.

The better you learn your stand, the more efficiently you can handle a busy day.

GROW YOUR STREET FOOD BUSINESS

Turn your earnings back into your business.

Expand your menu, purchase new equipment, improve your stand and seating area, and increase the number of customers you can serve.

What begins as a small street food stand can gradually become a busy part of the town.

Every Tower Is a Backpack!

Item TD is a Tower Defense × Inventory Management strategy game featuring a wide variety of item combinations. Conquer 15 stages, challenge 3 difficulty levels, and unlock Duel Mode.

This is a Tower Defense combat game built around inventory management. Place various weapons and support items in the inventories of your character and each Tower to maximize their synergies and fight off waves of incoming monsters.

You play as Beck, a fighter with an inventory for equipping various weapons and items to attack enemies. You can also place these weapons and items in Tower inventories to fight alongside your Towers. Managing Mana consumption for both Beck and your Towers, adjusting item positions to maximize their effects, and choosing inventory setups based on Tower locations are all key to victory.

Your other companion is Peko, a mage who chants a purification spell to destroy the source of the monsters. As monsters continuously approach her to interrupt the spell, you must fight them while protecting Peko until the chant is complete. During this time, you can use Gold dropped by monsters to upgrade Peko's abilities. Deciding whether to spend Gold on weapons and items or on upgrading Peko is another important strategic choice.

Completing stages grants skill points that can be used to improve various abilities of your character, Towers, reinforcements, and more. You can reset your skill points without limit to try different skill combinations and overcome the challenges ahead. These skills not only improve base stats but also unlock special abilities, such as moving Towers or making arrows bounce off walls. There is plenty to discover.

All items in the game can be purchased freely from shops, giving you full control over how you approach each stage. Items include weapons, support items, and powerful high-tier items created through forging. Experiment with different item combinations and discover a variety of playstyles.

The game features 15 stages, each playable on Normal, Hard, and Insane difficulties. Higher difficulties do more than increase monster Life; they also give monsters challenging special abilities that can completely change your strategy. Complete all stages across all difficulties to unlock Duel Mode, where you command your Towers and reinforcements against enemy Towers, troops, and powerful bosses in epic, war-like battles. Experience the unique fun of item-based Tower Defense!

You are the cursor. And you are not safe.

It's Just 45 Seconds is an action roguelite where your mouse cursor is part of the fight. Protect Bit while enemies grab, punch, and throw you out of position. Fight your way back before they reach him.

Protect Bit through the chaos

Protect Bit through intense 45-second rounds. Aim with your cursor, attack incoming threats, and activate cards during combat as different enemy patterns fill the screen. Combine your attacks with shields, pulses, and lasers to hold back the chaos.

Lose, buy cards, and try again

When you lose, time rewinds and the shop gives you a chance to prepare. Spend the points you earned on upgrades and cards you can activate during combat, then return to the fight with new tools and a new plan.

Choose what the shop can offer

Unlock cards and create deck profiles to control which cards can appear in the shop. Keep your pool small for more predictable choices, or bring more options and adapt to what you find.

Face bosses that change the rules

In boss fights, surviving is no longer enough: defeat the boss before time runs out. The rules can change during combat, with threats that spread across the play area and put your strategy to the test.

Almost overnight, the Ascendancy rose in the East: a rebel army fielding machines no upstart should be able to build.

The Union of Free Nations has an army capable of stopping the Ascendancy, but no minister willing to authorize a war. While faceless committees debate jurisdiction and spineless officials pass the blame, Union High Command quietly hires mercenary pilots to make the problem disappear.

Win, and the Union's propaganda machine will hail its decisive leadership. Die, and it never heard of you.

That is the contract.

Old School Firepower

JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Tear through hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, enormous war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

Bring Wingmen

Fly solo or sign the contract with up to two other pilots through online, LAN, or couch co-op.

Choose Your Loadout

3 pilots. 6 airframes. 9 ordnance types.

Finish the Job

10 missions. 11 major encounters.

Welcome to the Museum of 3D Jigsaw Puzzles!
Explore a museum filled with 2,576 scattered puzzle pieces and complete colorful works of art!

JIGSEUM: Assemble Jigsaws with Magic is a relaxing, first-person 3D jigsaw puzzle game where you explore an art museum at your own pace, collecting pieces and assembling a variety of 3D artworks.

From famous landmarks and paintings to animals, toys, food, and more, a wide variety of artworks awaits you. Collect the scattered pieces and put them all together!

Experience Jigsaw Puzzles in a Whole New Dimension!

Unlike traditional jigsaw puzzles, you'll be fitting pieces onto the surfaces of 3D artworks instead of a flat board.

Examine each artwork from different angles, using colors, patterns, and shapes as clues to figure out where each piece belongs.

Make Puzzle-Solving Easier and More Fun with Magic!

As you progress through the game, you'll earn points that you can use to unlock and upgrade magical abilities to help you explore the museum and solve puzzles.

Discover a variety of magical abilities to help you along the way:

  • Piece Lore: Highlights all pieces belonging to the same artwork as the piece you're holding.

  • Rotation: The piece you're holding glows when it's rotated to the correct orientation.

  • Magnet: Automatically snaps the piece you're holding into its correct position.

Watch Your Completed Artworks Come to Life!

Complete a puzzle and watch the finished artwork glow and magically come to life!

With every puzzle you complete, the museum becomes a little more colorful and lively.

Now, it's time to collect the scattered pieces and bring every artwork in the museum back to life!

There is a tragic legend in this world...
Actually, it's not tragic at all. We just turned Rock-Paper-Scissors into a real 'Game.'

◆ Your Choices Decide the Game: <Stat Allocation>

Want to be a real man? Go all-in on Rock. If you're scared, invest in HP. But what if your opponent invested all their stats into Paper?!
The mind games have already begun against an unknown foe.

※ You can become a Gigachad, but it comes at a steep price.

◆ Legalized Cheating: The Last One Laughing Wins. <Skill System!!>

Unleash good skills, bad skills, and downright dirty skills matching each character's personality to make your enemies feel pure despair.
Attacking on a draw, forcing the enemy to repeat their hand, throwing punches before the countdown even starts—embrace your inner villain!

※ A true Gigachad who hits on a draw just to secure the win.

◆ We All Had That One Kid in the Neighborhood... <AI~ Habits>

Seriously, they exist. The classic kid who only throws Rock, or plays Rock-Paper-Scissors in strict order. But wait!
From simple habits to avoiding hands that got hurt, countering your last move, or picking their highest-damage hand—advanced AI patterns mimicking real human psychology await you. Read their mind and win. (Win rates are hidden, watch out for bluffs!)

※ She kept throwing Rock, but inside, she was playing 4D Chess.

◆ Choose Your Flavor: <Duel Modes>

[Classic Duel] : The raw, spicy taste of pure dueling! (No upgrades)

[Plus Duel] : The sweet taste of DPS brute-forcing! (Full upgrades)

◆ Wake up, Samurai... we've got gold to grind. <Upgrade System>

[Common Upgrades] : Standard reward boosts and base physical stats found in every game.

[Character Upgrades] : Standard unique stats and skill upgrades found in every game.

[System Upgrades] : Upgrading secret reconnaissance features to spy on AI patterns one by one—rarely seen in other games!

 ※ At the end of the day, this is Rock-Paper-Scissors. Trust your luck and gut feeling.

IT'S TIME TO DUUUUUUUUUUUEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Live the Life of a Jockey. Build a Bloodline.

Your racing career begins at the age of 18.

You are a rookie jockey at a small family-run stable, riding unproven horses and trying to make a name for yourself.

Gain experience, win races, and earn opportunities to ride stronger horses on bigger stages.

But having the fastest horse is not enough.

Build Your Deck. Ride Your Race.

Before each race, build a deck suited to your horse's running style, abilities, the course, and the distance.

Take the lead. Settle your horse. Find a path through traffic. Time your move. Launch your final sprint.

Once the gates open, the race is constantly changing.

Watch your horse's stamina, your own focus, your position, and the distance remaining. Play your cards at the right moment and decide when to wait — and when to make your move.

Even with the same horse in the same race, the result can change depending on how you ride.

Develop Your Own Jockey

Your jockey grows through racing and everyday life.

Improve your five abilities — technique, starts, judgement, tension control, and drive — and unlock skills that shape the way you ride.

Master front-running tactics.
Become dangerous in the final stretch.
Turn lightning-fast starts into your greatest weapon.

What kind of jockey you become is up to you.

Learn What Makes Every Horse Different

Every racehorse has its own strengths, weaknesses, and personality.

Speed, stamina, power, dash, handling, obedience, preferred distance, and running style all affect how a horse performs.

Learn what each horse does best, compensate for its weaknesses, and find the riding style that brings out its full potential.

Breed the Next Generation

A horse's story does not have to end when its racing career is over.

Choose broodmares and stallions, study their abilities, bloodlines, and compatibility, and plan the next generation.

Then a new foal is born.

Which abilities will it inherit?
What hidden potential will it possess?

Name every foal born at your stable, raise the traits inherited from its parents, and build a bloodline that grows across generations.

Don't just create a champion.

Create a bloodline.

Build a Racing Life Around Your Family Stable

Your career is not limited to horses from your own stable.

As your reputation grows, other stables may offer you rides, giving you access to stronger horses and bigger races.

Choose which horses to ride, how to spend your time, and which skills to develop.

Grow from a rookie at a small family stable into a jockey capable of competing on racing's biggest stages.

Every Jockey's Career Comes to an End

A jockey's career cannot last forever.

One day, your time in the saddle will come to an end.

When that day comes, your own child takes the reins.

Their jockey abilities and reputation begin from zero, but the family stable, the farm, and the horse bloodlines you built remain.

Goals left unfinished in one lifetime can be pursued by the next generation.

It isn't only the horses that carry a bloodline.

And What Are You Riding Toward?

Breed a horse at your own stable.

Raise it from birth. Watch its potential emerge.

Then climb into the saddle yourself and take that horse to the very top of the racing world.

Building a bloodline is not the final goal.

It is the road that takes you there.

You may not make it in a single lifetime.

That is what the next generation is for.

Key Features

  • Jockey-focused racing combining deck building with tactical decisions

  • Racehorses with distinct abilities, running styles, strengths, weaknesses, and personalities

  • Jockey stat growth and a wide variety of skills

  • A racing life centered around your family stable

  • Opportunities to ride horses from other stables

  • Breeding based on broodmares, stallions, bloodlines, and compatibility

  • Foals that inherit different traits from both parents

  • Name and raise every foal born at your stable

  • Retire from riding and continue as your child

  • Carry your stable, farm, and horse bloodlines into the next generation

  • Breed a horse at your own stable and ride it toward the top of the racing world

Build and configure your JYSTICE. Enter Edenbyrg. Get out alive.

Build your own cybernetic JYSTICE in this lawful-but-awful roguehate top-down shooter, where you get to eradicate crime in the never-sleeping megacity of Edenbyrg. Create your own playstyle by augmenting your JYSTICE, modifying your Gavel rifle, and choosing fearless companions to suit the tasks at hand. Go solo or team up with a Co-JYSTICE in shared screen local co-op.

DEAL SWEET RUTHLESS JYSTICE

Will you be stealthy and lurk in the shadows? Or will you assault the evildoers head-on? Maybe you'll brutally rocket them to bits from a distance? Or perhaps bring your own squad of reckless companions to tackle the scenarios?

BUILD AND CONFIGURE

BILLIONS of different game-altering combinations enable you to find tools to fit your playstyle.

Use STEALTH augmentations to sneak silently through the shadows. Make yourself GIANT and hurl perps around. Make yourself tiny and fit through smaller cracks. Or combine augmentations: make yourself a tiny giant. Up to you.

THE GAVEL OF JYSTICE

Deal sweet, ruthless JYSTICE with your ultra-versatile and moddable weapon of the law: the Gavel.

§ Fire lead, lasers, and electricity modified with dozens of game-changing effects.

§ Persuade the perps to join your side with the Lovestruct mod, or bring your own army of drones or allies.

§ Fire rockets in the general direction of the enemy and hear that kneecap split from a distance.

§ Use the Dynamite Gavel mod to powerslam through walls and explode-gib your foes with a swift blow to the brainstem.

§ Smell the burning criminal flesh with the Flaming Plasma mod, or just gently knock them unconscious with the Sandman mod.

Your Gavel, your Law.

LOCAL VERSUS MODE - COURT OF JYSTICE

Gather up 2-4 players and settle your differences in VERSUS ARENAS OF JYSTICE. Run, shoot, dodge, groan, and fight for the ultimate prize: the deep respect of your future ex-friends!

EDENBYRG - YOUR URBAN PARADISE

The filthy stench of crime has taken over Edenbyrg. But do not despair: the lawful-but-awful JYSTICEs are designed to swiftly correct all lawless behavior.

Bank robbers have fortified themselves inside the MegaBank. There are four ways into the bank, but only one way out of the vault. How will you proceed?

Several Cobra Gang members have taken the Flanders family hostage. The family needs to be rescued. Preferably alive. Your move.

Rumors circulate in the darkest, rain-beaten alleys of Edenbyrg that someone is building a death machine. Something big and specifically designed to take out JYSTICEs. Arm yourself!

PERFORM HEROIC FEATS FOR MEDALS

Can you complete the scenario without firing a single shot? In under 15 seconds? Without being seen? With EVERYONE dead? With EVERYONE alive?

Your heroism and extraordinary feats will be rewarded with shiny medals. Medals unlock delicious new cyberware, weapon mods, fire modes, special weapons, and more.

For an even greater challenge, play through the extended five-act single-player campaign on the new Death Sentence difficulty, where you only have a limited number of JYSTICEs to use. What a thrill!

Start with an ordinary rough stone and experience the entire jadeite processing journey, from mining and window grinding to appraisal, cutting, and selling. Examine each stone, judge its quality, and perform every step yourself. Every stone could hide a valuable discovery—or turn out to be a costly disappointment.


  • Mine Rough Stones: Begin with handheld tools and gradually unlock drilling equipment for automated mining. Explore different mining sites and discover jadeite rough stones with unique characteristics and quality.

  • Inspect and Grind: Shine a flashlight through the rough stone to examine its translucency, color, and hidden fractures. Choose where to grind, carefully remove the outer layer, and reveal the jadeite beneath.

    Once the window is finished, the exposed jadeite, grinding results, and visible flaws determine its appraisal value. Careful decisions and precise workmanship can make all the difference.

  • Appraise Jadeite: Learn to distinguish natural jadeite from artificially treated stones. Examine color, structure, and internal features while identifying fractures, inclusions, and other imperfections that affect value. Don't be fooled by appearances.

  • Cut the Stone: Plan each cut and operate the cutting machine. Avoid fractures and preserve as much high-quality jadeite as possible. A poor cut could ruin your most valuable material.

  • Customize and Share Rough Stones: Share a specific rough stone with your friends using its unique Stone ID. Examine the same stone, compare ideas for where to open a window, and experiment with different cutting strategies. How would your friends approach the very same stone?

  • Sell and Upgrade: Sell your processed stones, invest in better tools and equipment, and unlock higher-tier mining sites. Work your way up from ordinary rocks to increasingly valuable jadeite rough stones.

From tamahagane to a finished katana.

Become a swordsmith in Bakumatsu-era Kyoto.

Japanese Swordsmith is a hardcore swordsmith simulator built around the traditional path of Japanese sword making. Sumikiri, mizuheshi, stacking and welding, folding forge, steel construction, drawing out, fire shaping, clay packing, the quench, polishing, and mounting.

Not a minigame—this is real work.

Learn the traditional craft path and forge your own katana from tamahagane.

Take on shapes inspired by famous and fictional blades.

The traditional craft path

  • Sumikiri (charcoal cutting) — cut and prepare charcoal for the forge fire with your own hands

  • Mizuheshi (break & sort) — heat and hammer tamahagane, quench it, then sort the broken pieces

  • Tsumiwakashi (stack & weld) — stack fragments and forge them into a single billet

  • Tanren (folding forge) — fold and hammer to refine the steel

  • Tsukurikomi (construction) — layer jacket and core steels into the blade's heart

  • Wakashinobe / Sunobe (drawing out) — draw the steel to length and shape the kissaki

  • Hizukuri (fire shaping) — form the edge, spine, curve, and the rest of the blade

  • Tsuchioki (clay packing) — paint the clay line that will become the hamon

  • Yakiire (the quench) — quench the heated blade and lock in the hamon—one shot, no undo

  • Togi (polishing) — remove clay on the stone and bring out jigane and hamon

  • Koshirae (mounting) — fit tsuka, tsuba, saya, and finish the sword as a whole

Read the steel. Make your best blade.

Watch the forge fire, the color of hot steel, the state of every strike—and finish the metal at its best. If you aim for a katana that will not break, will not bend, and will cut true, that attention is required.

A blade with your mark

The clay line you place becomes the hamon. Whether it rises cleanly depends on the steel and the quench. The work you put in shows in the blade's face—hamon, jigane, and character.

Lay out the forge your way

Place key tools, furniture, tamahagane, steel in progress, and blades where you want them. Chase efficiency or atmosphere—build the workshop in your own style.

The path of the swordsmith is long and steep.

Can you forge a blade worthy of history?

Streaming & Video Content

Streaming, gameplay videos, reviews, and other video content featuring Japanese Swordsmith are welcome for both individuals and organizations.

Content from publicly available versions of the game may be streamed or uploaded without prior permission. Monetization through platform features such as YouTube or Twitch is also permitted.

This is a visual novel game centered on the Gospel accounts of the Bible. Through chapter-based storytelling, character dialogue, and event CGs, players will step into the time of Jesus Christ and witness His teachings, miracles, compassion, sacrifice, redemption, and resurrection.

The game follows the life of Jesus Christ as its main narrative, presenting many important events from the Gospels. From the birth of John the Baptist, the baptism of Jesus, His temptation in the wilderness, the calling of the disciples, and the preaching of the Kingdom of Heaven, to healing the sick, comforting the weak, and facing doubt and temptation, players will gradually experience the journey that changed the world.

This is not a game focused on combat or puzzles, but a quiet, profound narrative experience filled with meaning and faith. Through the form of a visual novel, this game hopes to help players rediscover the messages, scenes, and Word of God found in the Gospels in a more immersive way.

Features

  • Centered on the life of Jesus Christ and the stories of the four Gospels

  • Chapter-based storytelling, suitable for players who enjoy story-driven and text-based experiences

  • Character emotions and the core of faith are presented through dialogue and narration

  • Recommended for players interested in the Bible, faith, history, and narrative-driven games

In a world of darkness, He brought light.
Among the broken, He brought hope.
This is a journey of sacrifice, compassion, redemption, and resurrection.

LANGUAGE NOTICE

This game currently supports Simplified Chinese only.

ENTER THE WORLD OF QINGHE

Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie is a historical life-simulation and narrative management RPG set in Qinghe County during the Northern Song dynasty. Take the role of Ximen Qing and shape a life among merchants, officials, household members, servants and ordinary townspeople.

  • MANAGE YOUR HOUSEHOLD AND BUSINESSES

Operate businesses, appoint managers, adjust prices, manage stock and develop your family estate. Wealth can open doors, but every investment consumes time, money and attention. A prosperous household also brings greater responsibilities and new risks.

  • BUILD RELATIONSHIPS

The people of Qinghe have their own schedules, desires, loyalties, secrets and conflicts. Friendship, affection, reputation, favors and resentment may change how they treat you—and how they treat one another when you are not present.

  • GATHER RUMORS AND EVIDENCE

Information does not arrive automatically. Talk to people, send servants to investigate, collect rumors and uncover evidence. What you know—and what you only think you know—can alter the course of disputes, investigations and personal relationships.

  • SET SCHEMES IN MOTION

Use your connections, resources and knowledge to arrange plans involving other characters. Choose the right people, timing and approach, then face the consequences when circumstances change or someone acts against your expectations.

  • LIVE WITH TIME AND CONSEQUENCES

Every journey, conversation and action takes time. Characters continue their lives according to their own circumstances. Health, illness, aging, family, birth and death gradually reshape the world around you.

  • CREATE YOUR OWN QINGHE STORY

Follow multiple narrative routes, pursue different ambitions and reach a variety of endings. Build a flourishing household, seek status and influence, protect the people important to you—or watch a seemingly small choice lead your life in an entirely different direction.

Some chefs source locally. John Whisk sources violently.

The dungeon beneath the kitchen is full of ingredients and every one of them fights back. Carrots hop. Tofu splits when you hit it. Corn detonates into a swarm of popcorn. Cauliflowers heal the things trying to kill you, peppers make them hit harder, and at the bottom of every floor, The Head Chef is waiting to plate you.

John Whisk is an action roguelite where the loot is food, the crafting is cooking, and the only way to keep what you found is to walk out with it.

Descend. Kill. Harvest.

Fight through fog-shrouded floors with a pan in one hand and a cleaver ready to throw. Every kill drops ingredients into your pouch which is on the line until you decide to go home.

Bank it, or push your luck.

Killing the floor boss gives you two options: go HOME or go DEEPER. Go home, and everything you've collected is yours. Go deeper, and the enemies get stronger, the haul gets bigger, and the risk grows. Die, and you lose the lot, plus the hospital bill.

Then cook it properly.

Back in your kitchen, turn the haul into real dishes. Slice, dice or mince on the cutting board, flip on the pan, watch the pot, time the oven, and plate it clean. Every dish is graded on how well you actually cooked it. A sloppy stir-fry is still edible. A perfect one changes you.

Eat to grow. Sell to gear up.

Eat a dish for a permanent stat gain. Slot one as a buff for the next run. Sell the surplus to buy gear, utensil

upgrades and new recipes. Collect matching gear for set bonuses.

Features

- Hand-drawn pixel-art

- Real risk: the only(?) way home is through the boss

- Extract-or-descend choice after every boss, with a pouch you can lose at any moment

- Five cooking minigames: cutting board, frying pan, boiling pot, oven, plating that grade your skill, not just your ingredients

- Permanent character growth through what you eat

- Fog of war, a minimap, and floors that get nastier the deeper you go

- Gear, gear sets, weapons and an expanding recipe book

You are what you eat. Make sure it's dead first.

Two against you. One trick card each battle. Take down the House.

Joker's Last Call is built on One Card, a fast Korean shedding game from the Crazy Eights family: match the suit or rank, stack attack cards into a growing penalty, and push it onto the next player. A short tutorial walks you through it.

Everyone draws from the same fixed deck — 52 cards and two Jokers — and nobody adds cards to it. Your edge comes from relics that stay on for the whole run, and a trick deck of up to five cards: each battle one is dealt to your sleeve, to use once. Relics are the rules. Tricks are the cheat.

DISCOVER KOREA'S ONE CARD

Joker's Last Call is based on One Card, a fast and fiercely competitive Korean card game rarely seen outside Korea. Match ranks or suits, stack draw penalties, and force the growing attack onto the next player—until someone breaks the chain.

Now that familiar Korean card-table chaos has been rebuilt as a dark casino roguelike, filled with rule-bending relics, ruthless rivals, and Jokers capable of reversing an entire match.

TURN DEFENSE INTO A COUNTERATTACK

Attack cards do not simply deal damage—they build a penalty that moves around the table. Defend with the right card, push the chain to the next rival, or hold your counter until the risk becomes unbearable.

ONE JOKER CAN FLIP THE ENTIRE MATCH

A Joker can stop a disaster or send it back across the table. Use it too early and you may have nothing left for the final hand. Wait too long and the house may collect first.

BUILD A RUN AROUND RULE-BENDING RELICS

Choose relics that alter draws, suits, attack chains, defense, and turn order. Build around aggression, counterplay, control, or survival—but adapt when the next reward refuses to fit your plan.

OUTPLAY TWO RIVALS AT ONCE

FACE THE HOUSE'S MOST DANGEROUS PLAYERS

Climb a branching casino map, take risks at events and shops, defeat elite opponents, and confront bosses with distinct personalities and tactics.

Korea's One Card. Reborn as a roguelike.
Stack the attack. Break the chain. Beat the house.

A paradise archipelago, corrupt and chaotic, ruled by a local mafia! Your mission is simple:

Pay your vig and survive another day!

Time is running out, and the pressure is on. Make money, plan your next moves carefully, and be prepared for whatever trouble comes your way!

Work hard, take on missions, deal with strange people, cause chaos or simply try to enjoy your days while trouble brews around you. The choice is yours!

Be careful with the decisions you make. After all, making enemies on these islands is easier than making hotdogs!

The story is ours, but the rules are yours!

Remember, you're joining us at the beginning of this adventure!

Junk Rush is a game where your free will is put to the test!

Prepare your hotdogs using a physics-based cooking system, where cooking is more than just selecting options from a menu.

Handle your hotdog, ingredients, utensils, and equipment while trying to keep your kitchen running without letting chaos take over and set everything on fire.

CUSTOMERS

Your job is to serve all kinds of customers: regulars, weirdos, culinary critics, or anyone else you can imagine walking into your kitchen. Each one can bring their own situations, demands, and problems.

But you don't have to simply serve your customers!

Threaten them, poison them, set them on fire, or commit any atrocity your imagination allows. The problem is, you never know how each customer will react.

FINDING INGREDIENTS

TIME IS RUNNING OUT

What you do with your time is up to you!

And if you simply don't want to make hotdogs, find "alternative" ways to make money. That's your problem!

In the end, your decisions and the way you choose to play will determine which of the multiple endings you'll discover!

The story is ours, but the rules are yours!

Four robots, one job

Dots is a classic strategy game played on a sheet of grid paper: red versus blue, each trying to surround the other. Just Dots brings it to the screen and gives it what it always lacked — a genuinely strong opponent.

An opponent that actually thinks

Under the hood is a neural network trained from scratch: it was given nothing but the rules and played millions of games against itself, never seeing a single human move. The result is an opponent that doesn't fall for cheap traps and weaves its own nets across half the board. On boards up to 20×20 it confidently beats its own creator; larger boards it is still mastering — and every update makes it stronger.

How to play

Take turns placing one dot at a time on the grid intersections. Close a chain of your dots around your opponent's — and everything inside is yours. Whoever captures more of the opponent's dots wins.

The catch: while you're weaving your encirclement, your opponent is weaving theirs. Every game becomes a race of traps, where sacrificing a single dot can win you twenty. Learning the rules takes two minutes. Becoming a master takes years.

  • Save and replay your games — see exactly how you got surrounded

  • Two openings: an empty board or the classic "cross" start

Who it's for

Fans of Go, chess, Reversi and abstract strategy with no dice and no luck. Anyone who played Dots in the back row at school and wants to find out how much they've learned since. And anyone who wants an opponent they can't figure out in three games.

Add to your wishlist — coming December 2026.

Start with the first stage of your first instinct. Play a short streak, beat the average, and the next tile grows. After five stages comes a remix stage that shuffles every question type — clear it to unlock the next instinct, until all 12 are up on the wall.

More ways to play

  • Free Mode — replay any stage you've unlocked in Main Mode

Clean, intuitive, ad-free

Hand-drawn line art, minimal interface, available in 9 languages. Pay once — no ads, no in-app purchases.

Game Overview

〈KISI: The Deja Vu〉 is a 3D anomaly-detection psychological horror adventure game based on the eerie sense of familiarity felt in a sanity-bending experimental facility—the phenomenon known as "Déjà Vu."

Players are trapped as test subjects in a disturbing experimental space created by the mad scientist Dr. Hoffmann. Within a perfectly symmetrical, decalcomania-structured space, you must observe surreal anomalies that shift in real time, overcome suffocating hallucinations, and attempt a desperate escape for your life.

Story

"I've never been here before... so why does everything feel so familiar?"

You wake up in a mysterious experimental location filled with chilly coldness and an unsettling silence.

Dr. Hoffmann, a mad scientist obsessed with manipulating human brains and memories, initiates a twisted psychological experiment using you as a test subject.

Two rooms that appear flawlessly duplicated, and a reality that gradually warps alongside cognitive distortions every time you step between them.

Under Dr. Hoffmann’s live surveillance and sadistic testing, players must doubt their own failing memories and senses to find the hidden exit.

Key Features

  • The Horrifying Evolution of "Spot the Difference"

    Going far beyond simple puzzles, this game presents the true essence of the "anomaly detection" genre recreated in a 3D space. Move between two identical-looking rooms and find the subtle changes.

  • 3D Anomaly Exploration from a Test Subject's Perspective

    Explore the entire experimental environment built by Dr. Hoffmann and closely observe subtle distortions occurring within the 3D space.

  • A Struggle of Observation and Cognition

    As you cross back and forth between paired spaces, discover bizarre and horrifying alterations designed to trigger the test subject's brain.

  • Psychological Pressure from a Mad Scientist & Intensified Horror

    Experience peak psychological terror that paralyzes your sanity through brutal sequences, hallucinations born from controlled environments, and the surreal nature of replicated spaces.

KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War

KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a solo-developed Three Kingdoms strategy game built around Realm-Unification Mode, connecting realm management on a grand map with streamlined real-time battles. Govern cities, raise armies and assign officers to key roles—but before a force marches, you must decide who will join it, where it will go and whether its food supply can sustain the operation.

Victory is not decided by troop numbers alone. Routes, food, formations, direction of attack, officer abilities and siege preparation all shape the outcome. An army can win a field battle and still fail at the city walls if its supplies collapse.

Govern Cities and Expand Your Realm


Your cities are the foundation of every war. Organise production, recruit troops, strengthen defences, search for new talent and assign officers to key positions. Each decision affects what you can send into the field and how long you can support it.

Before an expedition departs, choose its officers and consider the troop type each one commands. Decide how much food and equipment the force will carry, then plan a route to its next city or battlefield. A larger army may be more powerful, but it also demands more food and becomes harder to sustain during a long operation.

Officers with no assigned troops remain eligible for the battle roster, but in a defensive battle they must stay in the city for the initial deployment. They may sortie after receiving troops from later supplies. Both sieges and defensive battles may begin with no units in the initial formation, preserving forces for rotation and counterattack. A battle can field no more than eight officers; if more are available, first choose the eight-person roster, then decide who stays behind or deploys.

Computer Factions Weigh the Strategic Situation


Computer factions treat administration, recruitment, ordinary transport and expeditions as connected strategic choices. They compare target troops, officers, fortification durability and counter-fire, estimate the route, battle duration, food coverage and expected losses, and weigh rosters of up to eight officers. When a front is underprepared, they can consider transporting resources or reinforcing it before another operation.

These decisions are changing estimates, not hard rules that forbid an attack. A computer faction may still accept a risky opportunity or misjudge a situation as information and the front change; players can exploit its supply lines, troop movements and mistakes.

Shape the Realm Through Diplomacy


The full game's Realm-Unification Mode will track relations and Favor between factions, with states of war, truce and alliance. During annual administration, send an officer as an envoy to negotiate a truce, renew an agreement or propose an alliance. Bargain over the terms using gold, food, siege engines or the return of captured officers; goodwill gifts and treaty decisions also change Favor.

Computer factions assess relative strength, common enemies, active fronts and Favor when proposing, renewing or ending agreements, and AI factions also conduct diplomacy with one another. Alliances can open safe passage through allied territory, so diplomacy changes both the political map and the routes available to armies.

Food Is the Clock Behind Every War






Food is more than a resource stockpiled in your cities. It determines how long your armies can march, fight and maintain a siege.

  • Cities consume food each day to support their population, garrison and reserve troops.
  • An expedition carries food when it departs. Consumption rises with army size and with the time spent marching or fighting.
  • Both sides continue consuming food during a field battle. If one force runs out, it can be forced to withdraw. If both sides deplete their supplies at the same time, the engagement can end with both armies disengaging.
  • Sieges place a heavier supply burden on the attacker. An attacking army without food must retreat. If the defender’s food reaches zero, disorder breaks out inside the city and the city begins losing durability as the siege continues.
  • A supply collapse on the strategic map can cost additional troops and trigger a rapid rout.
  • Some tactics can raid enemy supplies directly, while certain Advisor Skills can reduce food consumption.

Send Supplies That Must Reach the Battlefield






During a battle, you can dispatch food and reserves from a friendly city only when it has stock, is out of combat and has an open route to the battlefield. Confirming the dispatch actually deducts the selected food and reserves from the source city. They do not appear at the front instantly: the convoy must travel the route, and the supplies take effect only after it arrives.

Ordinary transport and battlefield resupply serve different purposes. Ordinary transport assigns one officer, carries no combat troops, and transfers food, gold, reserves and siege engines between sites. Battlefield resupply is tied to one active battle and delivers only food and reserves to that front. Both travel along real routes, but their cargo has a different destination and use after arrival.

The interface shows the source stock, journey and estimated arrival time, and totals the convoys, food and reserves en route to or waiting for that battle. Warnings appear as battlefield food falls to 75%, 50% and 25% or less of the opening supply, giving you time to act before the supply line collapses.

Winning a battle therefore requires more than defeating the enemy in front of you. You must manage your remaining supplies and judge whether the army can still complete its objective, wait for a convoy or withdraw safely after the fighting is over.

March to Relieve a Siege


When one of your cities is under siege, you can redirect an idle army already on the map or select officers in an eligible friendly city and dispatch a new relief force. Reinforcements do not teleport into the battle: they carry their own food and march along the actual road network, so their supplies must cover the journey. On arrival, they intercept the chosen besieging army on the road outside the city and begin a separate encounter battle.

Read the Formation Before You Commit


When armies meet, the game shifts from strategic planning to real-time command. Troop type, formation, facing and whether a unit is already engaged all matter.

  • Cavalry units build charge while moving, then convert that momentum into additional damage on impact.
  • A prepared spear formation can intercept a frontal cavalry charge—but only while it is facing the attack, has not been broken and is not already locked in close combat.
  • Archer fire can temporarily suppress a spear formation, creating an opening for cavalry or infantry. Archers, however, become vulnerable when enemies close the distance.
  • Infantry is suited to frontal engagements and can anchor the line while other units manoeuvre.

Spear formations do not automatically stop cavalry, and cavalry cannot simply charge through every prepared spear formation. Timing, facing and whether the spears are already engaged decide whether the interception succeeds.

Break the Fortifications






Siege battles add gates, walls and specialised equipment to the battlefield. Battering rams attack city gates, ladders support assaults at close range, and ballistae and catapults apply pressure from a distance.

The strategic fortification rating becomes both city durability and defensive counter-fire in a formal siege. Units attacking gates, walls and other defensive targets take return damage; while the fortifications remain intact, that counter-fire can steadily wear down the attacker. Breaking the durability and opening the defence is therefore part of winning the siege.

Siege engines are committed and consumed once per expedition. Confirming dispatch immediately deducts the selected engines from the site's stock, and they apply only to that expedition. In a formal siege, each committed engine increases the attacker's damage to gates, walls and other fortification targets by 1.8%, up to a total bonus of 22%. Defender stock and field battles do not trigger this bonus.

Committed engines are not returned after arrival, withdrawal, garrisoning or occupation. Moving siege engines by ordinary transport is only a stock transfer between sites and does not consume them as expedition supplies. An otherwise powerful army may still fail if it reaches the walls without enough equipment—or runs out of food before it can finish the assault.

After capturing a city, any unspent gold carried by that expedition can fund an immediate fortification repair. Repairs use the domestic construction rate and can restore defenses only up to their pre-battle value; loot and the city’s existing treasury do not increase this emergency budget.

Choose How Much to Command


The battle system supports three control styles:

  • Manual — issue movement and attack orders directly.
  • Semi Auto — combine player orders with automated unit behaviour.
  • Full Auto — let the AI direct the battle and observe how your preparations play out.

You can take direct command when detailed positioning matters, or focus on army composition, logistics and preparation before letting the battle unfold.

Battlefield input uses left-click to select formations and right-click to issue movement or attack orders. Press Space to pause or resume battle time while keeping the camera and command controls available, and press Tab to select the next officer whose Stratagem is ready. Improved terrain-aware pathfinding helps player and computer formations route around rivers, walls and blocked ground toward bridges, fords and other reachable passages.

Battle Arts and Stratagems Follow Different Rules




Officer attributes and combat roles affect battlefield performance. Each officer commands a particular troop type, so the officers you deploy also determine the shape of your army. Battle Arts and Stratagems are two different ability systems.

  • Battle Arts are generally carried by martial officers and rely heavily on Might and current strength. They activate automatically once Morale is full and the relevant conditions are met.
  • Stratagems are generally carried by advisers or commander-type officers. In manual and semi-automatic battles, you control their activation timing and target. Only fully automatic mode lets the AI control Stratagems for both sides.
  • Targeting can be immediate, at a designated location, or in a designated direction. The battlefield displays the expected area or direction while aiming; canceling or releasing at an invalid target does not consume the Stratagem.

Battle Arts and Stratagems can deal direct or area damage, strengthen allies, hinder enemies, alter Morale, restore strength, create Ambushes, damage buildings, apply fire or Bleeding, and control movement.

Settle the Clash in a Duel


Under the right battle conditions, two officers may challenge each other to a duel. A duel can occur at most once per battle. Refusing a challenge—or the outcome of an accepted duel—can affect morale.

During a duel, choose among three primary attacks—Slash, Thrust and Rising Strike—which form a three-way counter system:

  • Slash counters Thrust.
  • Thrust counters Rising Strike.
  • Rising Strike counters Slash.

Counter, Guard and Evade provide limited-use defensive alternatives. Reading the opponent and deciding when to spend those options is as important as choosing the right attack.

Seven Playable Sandbox Starts


Realm-Unification Mode currently includes seven playable sandbox starts: “Yellow Turban Rebellion (184 CE),” “Coalition Against Dong Zhuo (189 CE),” “Warlords Divided (196 CE),” “Battle of Guandu (200 CE),” “Battle of Red Cliffs (208 CE),” “Liu Bei Enters Shu (211 CE),” and “Three Kingdoms (222 CE).” Choose an available faction and enter the strategic map from that scenario’s initial territorial situation to manage cities, organise armies, expand your realm and pursue unification.

These starts are open-ended strategic setups rather than separate historical campaigns. They do not include individual chains of historical events or scenario-specific scripted victory objectives, and they offer a different style of play from the story-driven Historical Campaign included with the full game.

Unify the Realm Within One Hundred Years


Each scenario counts a full 100 in-game years from its own starting date. Control every city before the deadline to complete unification; otherwise the campaign ends with the “A Century Unfinished” outcome. The full game contains 49 achievements covering first victories, captures, successful defenses, relief and supply battles, city and officer milestones, and unification with different scenarios and factions.

Historical Campaign Included in the Full Game






Alongside Realm-Unification Mode, the full game will include the complete Historical Campaign Mode. Enter story-driven battles from the chapter and stage browser, with narrative introductions and different battlefield objectives. This content will be delivered with the full game and will not be sold as separate DLC.

The seven sandbox starts in Realm-Unification Mode and the Historical Campaign are two different ways to play: Realm-Unification Mode lets you freely govern a faction and pursue unification, while the Historical Campaign progresses through chapters, stories and stage objectives.

Full-Game Scope


The game will not enter Early Access and will be released as a complete single-player game. Full version v1.0 will include Realm-Unification Mode with seven sandbox starts and the complete Historical Campaign Mode. Essential maintenance, bug fixes and balance updates will continue after release.

Developed Independently


This is a solo-developed game. Its strategic map, city management, logistics, real-time battles, sieges, tactics and duels form one complete realm-unification loop.

STORY

Is it an urban legend, a mystery... or something else?

— One day in August, 2026 —

You become a paranormal influencer and head to the remote region of Kirigasawa in pursuit of fame and fortune—a place rumored to have swallowed up several influencers who vanished while filming there.

When you step off the bus, you're greeted by a beautiful sea of trees surrounded by towering mountains.

Beautiful, that is... except for the ominous signs.

Eager to begin filming, you soon discover your first destination—a ruined hospital—and eagerly make your way toward it.

Suddenly, you lose consciousness.
When you finally open your eyes again...

You're inside a hospital straight out of 1970s Japan—and it's no longer a ruin!

Then, your phone begins to ring...
Even though you should have no signal.

SYSTEM

■ Multiple Playthroughs, Multiple Endings
Four endings in total, including conclusions unique to each playthrough and the True End.

With each playthrough, new areas gradually unlock, and the story unfolds further.

Your actions determine which ending you reach.

■ No Difficulty Selection
There are no selectable difficulty levels.

■ Auto Save / Manual Save
Both automatic and manual saving are supported.
Auto saves occur at specific points, and an indicator will appear on screen while the game is being saved.

■ Graphics Settings
Includes adjustable graphics quality, FPS limits, and other display settings.

Thirty days to save a friend


Cedar Falls, Ohio. Summer 1997. You are Sam, fifteen, helping clear out your grandmother's house. In the attic you find Kris: an old household robot with a gentle heart and a deadline. In thirty days, he will be sent to the scrap press.

You may be the only person willing to speak for him.

New skills have a cost


A box of floppy disks lets Kris learn to fix, grow and make things. Each disk changes the way he talks and sees the world. Swap them as you solve puzzles together. But if you want to expand the space he has for abilities, you must erase one of his memories. That choice cannot be undone.

A summer in Cedar Falls


Wander from the diner to the cinema, the lake and the old factory. Meet the people who grew up alongside the town's robots. Listen to their stories, look closer at what they have left behind and find your own way forward.

  • Classic point-and-click puzzles with no dead ends
  • Ability disks that change Kris's personality and responses
  • Hand-drawn pixel art, warm humour and help when you want it

The feel of the late eighties


KRIS is set in the summer of 1997, but it looks and sounds like a point-and-click adventure from the end of the eighties – somewhere between 8-bit and the first 16-bit machines like the Amiga and Atari ST, when swapping disks was part of playing. 32 colours, crisp pixels and more than a thousand animations. The music is composed in that style too, and it never simply stops. When the scene changes, it waits for the next bar and flows into the new melody, just like the LucasArts classics. We allowed ourselves a few modern liberties in sound and animation. The feeling of those years is still there.

What will be left when it matters?


At summer's end, Kris's fate rests with the people he helped — and with you. The memories you chose to keep will shape what you can say for him. The ones you erased will leave a silence.

How much of a life can you trade away to save it?

SURVIVE THE MEATGRINDER

KRUSHPIT is an intense roguelike survival game where you fight through endless hordes of mutants right in the middle of rusty garages and grim concrete panels. Wipe out everything in your path, grab the loot, and stay alive as long as you can.

UPGRADE & BECOME OP

Kill enemies to earn XP and level up! Every upgrade drops with a random rarity (from Common to Mythic), making every run unique. Combine guns, artifacts, character passives, and discover hidden Skill Evolutions to break the game and become OP!

SPIN THE SLOTS, TAKE THE RISK

Got some spare cash from your run? Find a Slot Machine on the map and test your luck! Spin the reels to hit the jackpot, get free level-ups, or earn rare currency. Risk it all to scale your power faster!

REAL-TIME PVP LADDER

Tired of smashing mobs? Jump into the competitive PvP mode and face off against real players! Prove your skills, outlive your opponent, and steal their MMR. Climb the global leaderboard and show everyone who the real boss of KRUSHPIT is!

Kachow Kart Racing is a fast, chaotic, and fun arcade kart racer set on colorful tracks. Race online with your friends, customize your kart, and fight for the lead around every corner!

Hit the Track with Your Friends

Challenge your friends in online races or enjoy local split-screen racing on the same screen. Race solo against AI opponents, or take on other players in online ranked races and climb the leaderboard.

Whether you're racing casually with friends or fighting for a higher rank, every corner counts!

Create Your Clan, Grow Together

Create your own clan or join an existing one. Bring your friends aboard, recruit new members, and compete against other clans. Prove yourself on the track, make a name for your clan, and share the excitement of racing together!

Drift, Boost, and Turn the Race Around

Drift through corners, gain speed with boosts, and collect power-ups along the track. Use smoke bombs, shields, oil traps, and other abilities at the right moment to disrupt your rivals or protect yourself from attacks. One well-timed move can change the entire race!

The easy-to-learn driving system lets you jump straight into the action. Mastering it means perfecting your drift timing, managing your boosts, and making the most of your abilities.

Customize Your Kart Your Way

Head to the garage and give your kart your own style. Customize and upgrade your ride with different karts, wheels, and engines, then hit the track with a range of characters. Purchase new tracks, learn their layouts, and get ready to race with your favorite setup.

Kachow Kart Racing brings the fun of classic kart racing together with arcade handling, kart customization, online racing with friends, and clan competition.

Key Features

  • Online Racing with Friends: Join the same race and battle it out on the track.

  • Clan System: Join a clan or create your own, recruit new members, and challenge rival clans.

  • Kart Customization and Upgrades: Build your own setup with different karts, wheels, and engines.

  • Online Ranked Races and Leaderboard: Challenge other players and climb the ranks.

  • Local Split-Screen: Race with your friends on the same screen.

  • Single-Player Races: Compete against AI opponents.

  • Drifting and Boosting: Turn every corner into a chance to gain speed.

  • Race Abilities: Time your smoke bombs, shields, oil traps, and other abilities to gain the upper hand.

  • Different Characters: Choose your favorite character and hit the track.

  • Colorful Tracks and Progression: Purchase new tracks and race across different courses.

Welcome to Kaironia 

    Kaironia is a 2D idle and incremental RPG built from the ground up for fans of classic, retro MMORPGs. Relive the nostalgic days of endless skilling, deep progression, and hunting for the perfect loot drop; all distilled into a streamlined, friction-free idle experience.

Master Classic Skills 

    Cut down towering trees, mine precious ores, fish the local waters, and forage for rare herbs. Then, process your hard-earned materials through skills like Smithing to forge powerful gear. With mathematical pacing designed for the long haul, reaching level 99 in any skill is a true badge of honor.

Engaging Combat & Loot

    Equip your best Melee, Ranged, or Magic gear and take on fearsome monsters and bosses. Farm for rare drops, fill your bank with wealth, and optimize your loadout to become a legendary hero.

Respects Your Time: The Time Bank

    Your adventure doesn't stop when you close the game. Kaironia features a robust offline progression system that banks your away time, down to the second. Log back in and use your accumulated Time Bank to fast-forward through actions, allowing you to play at your own pace without needing to leave your PC running overnight.

A Living, Shared World

    Don't want to idle alone? Kaironia features optional self-hosted multiplayer where you can show off your hard-earned gear, trade resources, or just stand around a bank complaining about the grind with your friends.

Key Features:

  • Retro RPG Nostalgia: A classic aesthetic, grid-based world, and a gameplay loop that captures the golden age of online RPGs.

  • Deep Skilling System: Gather resources across multiple disciplines and process them into valuable goods and upgrades.

  • Friction-Free Gameplay: We've eliminated the tedious micromanagement of hyper-specific "skilling outfits." Gear up for combat with your best stats and gather freely without constant inventory swapping.

  • True Offline Progression: Accumulate 1:1 progress time while offline and use it to accelerate your actions when you return.

  • Dynamic Paperdoll System: See every piece of armor and weapon you equip visually represented on your character.

  • A Balanced Grind: A meticulously balanced progression curve designed to offer hundreds of hours of satisfying gameplay.

  • Classic Game Modes: Choose how you play. Go standard drifter, challenge yourself with 'Lone Drifter' (no trading), or risk it all in 'Mortal Mode' (Hardcore permadeath). Play on legacy mode with active clicking, no item stacking, and loot drop on death for a punishing MMO-like experience, or set the XP and loot to 3x for an easy, casual experience. Play the game the way you enjoy!

  • The Grand Codex: A completionist's dream. Track every item you've ever discovered, master the Bestiary by studying monster drops, and fill out your massive collection log.

  • Quests & NPCs: Engage with a full dialogue and questing system. Talk to the locals, solve their problems, and uncover the secrets of the world.

Kaironia is available now in Early Access. Start your adventure today!

Kankao in Action is a 2-player co-op adventure with local and online co-op, where teamwork is not just important — it is the only way forward.

Work together to overcome obstacles, face teamwork-based challenges, and survive chaotic moments that demand coordination, communication, and timing. Every stage is designed around cooperation, so both players must help each other constantly to move forward.

This is not the kind of game where one player can do everything alone. The core of the experience is solving problems together, supporting each other, and trying not to turn the adventure into an even bigger disaster.

If you enjoy co-op games with humor, chaos, and fun for two players, Kankao in Action was made for you.

At the end of the journey, there is only one goal: find their girlfriends.

Features:

- 2-player co-op gameplay

- Local and online co-op

- Teamwork-based challenges and obstacles

- A lighthearted adventure full of humor and chaotic moments

- Progression built around cooperation, coordination, and communication

Kaperfahrt is your pirate sandbox you've been waiting years for.

⚓ Over 200 captains populate the Caribbean, each with their own goals and personality
⚓ 23 unique pirates on the Blacklist, each with their own agenda and combat style
⚓ 5 houses fight for political power in the Caribbean, and you decide whose side you're on
⚓ Handcrafted quests interwoven with every game mechanic
⚓ Direct, tactical real-time naval combat
⚓ An economy that reacts entirely to the world, blockade a port, let its stores run dry, then sell your cargo at the highest price

Master the naval battle

Close in, turn at the right moment, and let your broadside speak. Direct, tactical real-time naval combat. Read the wind, position yourself well, and send enemy ships to the depths or board them for their cargo.

A world that truly lives

Kaperfahrt's Caribbean is sailed by over 200 captains, each with their own goals, personality, and plans. They sail, trade, scheme, and pursue their own agendas, whether you're there or not. You don't move through a backdrop. You move through a sea full of independent captains living their own lives.

23 infamous pirates

Hunt down 23 unique pirate captains, each with their own agenda, goals, and unmistakable combat style. No two enemies play alike. Clearing the Blacklist means figuring out every single one.

An economy driven entirely by the world

There are no fixed prices pulled from a table here. The economy responds completely to what happens in the world. Blockade a port and its stores run dry. Supplies vanish, prices climb, and your cargo commands top coin. Supply and demand aren't background noise. They're your sharpest tool.

5 houses fighting for the Caribbean

Five powerful houses vie for political control. Take a side, play them against each other, or turn their war to your own advantage. Your actions shift the balance of power in the New World.

Handcrafted quests that weave it all together

Forget generic repeatable busywork. Kaperfahrt's quests are built by hand and reach into every system in the game: economy, politics, naval combat, and the captains of the world. Everything is interlocked, so your decisions carry real consequences.

Kart League Manager

Kart League Manager is a 4v4 kart racing manager. Take charge of a Division 4 team and climb all the way to the Division 1 title across 12 themed tracks.

Fight for the title against the other teams in a 12-team league.

Scout, buy and sell drivers, and build your squad within your budget.

Ban the maps your rival loves and pick the ones your drivers race best on.

Put four of your six drivers on the starting grid and choose a kart for each slot. Each of the six karts has its own special ability.

One winner is not enough. Watch four drivers push, block and cover for each other in 4v4 team races.

Choose training subjects and intensity, and bring in coaches.

After every match comes a press conference. Promise your drivers a win.

Enter the Winter Solo Cup, where each driver's solo ranking counts.

Up to 8 players each run their own team in the same league.

"Kasasaburo's Secret Fishing Spot"

is a desktop idle pixel fishing game.You will meet the mysterious frog angler, Samurō, and spend quiet days by the lake catching all kinds of curious fish, selling them for coins, upgrading your gear, and building your very own secret fishing spot.

Samurō’s Secret Fishing Spot is a relaxing, heartwarming little game full of calm, comfort, and gentle presence.

In a small corner of your desktop sits a quiet island, full of life. But beneath the calm, the true face of Blackstone Mountain is only beginning to show: ancient forests where the canopy blots out the sky, a reeking garbage mountain swarming with flies, a mushroom grove in wild, hallucinatory colors... What looks like a laid-back desktop companion hides the most mysterious journey of all.

Raise all kinds of bug bait and reel in ever stranger fish... though some fish are awfully picky eaters.

This little world is full of surprises. A bottle drifts in from afar — does it carry a request, or a secret? What's with the rain of bugs? A terrifying Ghost Angler roams at night... and beneath that calm water lurks a boss fish!?

Work Mode: double the slacking! Fish while you work. The mysterious work system doesn't just bring extra rewards — the longer you stay, the more secrets you'll uncover.

Layer. Blend. Matching colors disappear.

Place colored pieces onto the board. Red, blue and yellow blend into purple, green and orange; all three together make black, and white lightens whatever it touches. Layer the same color again and that component cancels out and vanishes. Match every cell of the target pattern to clear the puzzle.

Exactly one solution — always

Every puzzle is generated backwards from a finished board, and its uniqueness is verified by an exhaustive count. You will never stumble onto an accidental second answer.

1000 puzzles, graded by depth — not by color count

Four tiers — Easy (4x4, three colors), Normal, Hard and Oni — with the piece count stepping up inside each tier. Adding more colors does not make a puzzle harder; only how many pieces stack on a single color does. That structure is the difficulty curve.

Only the good boards made the cut

Far more puzzles were generated than shipped, then ranked by "small color clumps, many distinct colors" and taken from the top. The selection exists for one reason: so that neighboring cells blend into many different colors.

Built to sit well in the hand

Play with mouse or keyboard. Each of the twelve actions takes up to two key bindings, and the wheel swaps pieces. The board is drawn like layered sheets of colored washi paper.

From one struggling artist to a global webtoon empire

A blank canvas, a deadline, and a dream. Draw your first chapter, hit publish, and watch the readers pour in — or roll their eyes. Every chapter you make and every deal you sign builds the studio you've always wanted to run.

Fully localized in 11 languages: English · Türkçe · Deutsch · Français · Italiano · Português · Español · 한국어 · 日本語 · 中文 · Русский

🎮 Wishlist now

The great storm has spat you out. Helpless, you cling to the wreckage of a ship — until you are finally rescued. But in this world, rescue is only the beginning.

Keep to the Blue is set in a harsh, post-apocalyptic world where the seas have swallowed the old civilization. Between scattered settlements, drifting wrecks, and dangerous waters, your new life at sea begins.

YOUR SHIP IS YOUR HOME

Start with little more than a raft and work your way up to larger and more powerful vessels. Upgrade your ship, adapt it to your playstyle, and decide what kind of captain you want to become.

A heavily armed bulwark? A fast ship built for dangerous expeditions? Or perhaps a freighter for profitable trade routes?

FIGHT FOR VALUABLE LOOT

You are rarely alone on these waters. Face off against other ships, bring your weapons to bear, and fight for valuable loot.

What you seize in one battle may make all the difference in the next.

VENTURE INTO THE UNKNOWN

Explore the flooded world and uncover what lies hidden among the remains of the old civilization.

But the farther you stray from safer waters, the greater the danger becomes. Out there, pirates are waiting... and worse.

KEEP TO THE BLUE!
